GKN-Phantom v5.3.0 — Quick Combat Impact Chain Completed

- Quick Combat Mode impact chain now fully implemented: from nuclei/built-in quick probes, to content-aware severity escalation, deep-dive adapter exploitation, parameter probing for SQLi/SSTI, through auto PoC/exploit generation and bundled combat reports.
- New: Deep-dive adapters for exposed content (Actuator, GraphQL, Swagger) and parameter discovery with error-based injection probing.
- Retains all v5 features: interactive browser agent (Playwright), multi-format reports (HTML/PDF), YAML rule config with hot-reload, and comprehensive test suite.
- Supports 38 vulnerability types, 25+ WAF fingerprints, and 20+ attack chain patterns.
- Strict safety controls enforced: in-scope/authorized testing only; reproducibility gate guarantees findings are live and reproducible.
- Usable by trigger phrases including "penetration test," "security audit," "vulnerability scan," and equivalents in Chinese.
